title: Create Lesson – One-time – Group – Class Member Archived – Student Not Auto-Assigned
description: Feature Impact (Class Assignment / Master Queue) - Decision Table: Creating a one-time Group lesson for a Class must not auto-assign a Student Session to a student whose Class Member has been archived by the Lesson Allocation soft-delete.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce.
- Class A exists, linked to Course Math 101 and Location Tokyo HQ.
- Student A has a Class Member record on Class A whose Lesson Allocation has been archived (Archived_At__c is populated) after its Student Package Order was fully removed, so Class Member Is_Archived__c = TRUE.
- Student B has a Class Member record on Class A with an active Lesson Allocation (Archived_At__c is blank), so Class Member Is_Archived__c = FALSE.
- No lesson exists for Class A on 2026-05-20.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff creates a new one-time Group lesson for Class A on 2026-05-20"
2. "The system completes the Class Member auto-assignment job for the new lesson"
3. "HQ or CM Staff opens the new lesson's Student Sessions related list and looks for Student B"
4. "HQ or CM Staff looks for Student A in the same related list"
steps_result:
1. "The lesson is created with Draft status"
2. "The job completes with no error"
3. "Student B's Student Session is listed, auto-assigned by the job"
4. "Student A's Student Session is absent; Student A was not auto-assigned"
steps_data:
1. "class = Class A; lesson_date = 2026-05-20"
2. ""
3. "Student B Class Member Is_Archived__c = FALSE -> included"
4. "Student A Class Member Is_Archived__c = TRUE -> excluded"

title: Create Lesson – One-time – Group – Lesson Allocation Unarchived – Student Auto-Assigned After Restore
description: Feature Impact (Class Assignment / Master Queue) - Decision Table: After a previously archived Lesson Allocation is unarchived (its Class Member returns to Is_Archived = FALSE on the same record), a new Group lesson created for the same Class must auto-assign that student, proving the archive filter does not permanently block a restored student.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce.
- Class A exists, linked to Course Math 101 and Location Tokyo HQ.
- Student A previously had its Class Member on Class A archived, then unarchived after a living Student Package Order reappeared for the same Student Course, so the same Class Member record now has Is_Archived__c = FALSE.
- No lesson exists for Class A on 2026-05-21.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff creates a new one-time Group lesson for Class A on 2026-05-21"
2. "The system completes the Class Member auto-assignment job for the new lesson"
3. "HQ or CM Staff opens the new lesson's Student Sessions related list and looks for Student A"
4. "HQ or CM Staff opens Student A's Lesson Allocation record"
steps_result:
1. "The lesson is created with Draft status"
2. "The job completes with no error"
3. "Student A's Student Session is listed, auto-assigned by the job"
4. "Exactly one Lesson Allocation record exists for Student A on this Student Course, with the same record Id as before the archive"
steps_data:
1. "class = Class A; lesson_date = 2026-05-21"
2. ""
3. "Student A Class Member Is_Archived__c = FALSE (restored) -> included"
4. "One record, same Id across archive -> unarchive"
